preferredChannels.title: Permanent preferred Twitch channels
preferredChannels.description: Your creator-managed list is kept between streams. One login per line or comma-separated.

viewerSuggestionsEnabled.title: Let viewers suggest channels with a Twitch reward

viewerSuggestionRewardId.title: Viewer suggestion reward ID
viewerSuggestionRewardId.description: Create a Streamer.bot-owned Twitch reward that requires text input, then paste its stable reward ID here.

oneViewerSuggestionPerStream.title: Allow one suggestion per viewer each stream

announceViewerSuggestions.title: Confirm accepted or rejected suggestions in Twitch chat

viewerSuggestionRejectedMessage.title: Rejected suggestion message
viewerSuggestionRejectedMessage.description: Tokens: {viewer}, {channel}. Keep this generic so blocked-channel rules remain private.
viewerSuggestionRejectedMessage.default: {viewer}, that raid suggestion could not be added.

maximumFollowedPages.title: Maximum followed-stream pages
maximumFollowedPages.description: Each page is one Twitch request. Two is recommended.

currentAudienceEstimate.title: Fallback current audience estimate
currentAudienceEstimate.description: Zero uses the broadcaster's live viewer count returned by Twitch.

preferSimilarSize.title: Prefer channels near the current audience size

preferredLanguage.title: Preferred Twitch language code
preferredLanguage.description: Examples: en, es, fr. Leave empty for any language.

excludedCategories.title: Excluded categories
excludedCategories.description: Case-insensitive partial matches, one per line.

excludedTags.title: Excluded tags
excludedTags.description: Case-insensitive partial matches, one per line.

recentRaidStreams.title: Do not repeat a destination for this many streams

announceConfirmedRaid.title: Announce only after Twitch accepts the raid

announceNoCandidate.title: Post a no-candidate message in Twitch chat
announceNoCandidate.description: Disabled by default to keep search progress private.

noCandidateMessage.title: No-candidate message
noCandidateMessage.default: Raid Scout could not find a safe live destination with the current filters.

showSearchProgress.title: Show each search phase on the Raid Scout overlay
showSearchProgress.description: Shows preferred, followed, and same-category checks as private overlay progress. It does not post those steps to chat.

showSuggestionCard.title: Show suggestions in the Raid Scout browser card
showSuggestionCard.description: Enabled so a private OBS/Meld/browser dock can show what Confirm will raid. Disable this if the same URL is placed on-stream and you want suggestions hidden from viewers.

showConfirmedCard.title: Show the confirmed Next Stop card

previewClipBeforeRaid.title: Play one random clip before starting the confirmed raid
previewClipBeforeRaid.description: After Confirm, Raid Scout requests a bounded clip list for the selected channel, plays one official Twitch clip embed, then starts the raid. If no usable clip is available, it proceeds without one.

pauseOtherVideoOverlays.title: Pause other THSV video overlays during the raid preview
pauseOtherVideoOverlays.description: Recommended. Confirming a raid temporarily fades and pauses Random Clip Player or another coordinated THSV video overlay so the two clips cannot overlap.

clipLookupCount.title: Clips considered for random selection
clipLookupCount.description: Streamer.bot requests this many public clips for the selected channel. One is chosen locally at random.

clipPreviewMuted.title: Mute the raid clip preview
clipPreviewMuted.description: Keep enabled when browser-source autoplay blocks audio. OBS browser sources normally support unmuted playback.
